cases.description: Whole model, Current model, every listed category (elements with no owner view)
manualSteps: Open 'Snowdon Towers Sample HVAC.rvt' in Revit 2026 with the 'Snowdon Towers Sample Architectural' link loaded, and open the Model Context panel (RevitDevTool tab > Model Context).
Choose Scope 'Whole model' in the panel.
In the document list check only 'Current model'.
Open the Filter tab and click + (New custom filter).
Leave Categories empty (every listed category counts).
Read the number before 'matches' in the result row: it must be 2910.

Check without the panel: Revit has no single count of every listed element. Add up the per-category counts on the panel's Explorer tab (same scope and documents) and compare; the oracle recounts it with a plain element collector.

manualSteps: Open 'Snowdon Towers Sample HVAC.rvt' in Revit 2026 with the 'Snowdon Towers Sample Architectural' link loaded, and open the Model Context panel (RevitDevTool tab > Model Context).

cases.description: Whole model, link unchecked: Doors in Current model only: Doors
manualSteps: Open 'Snowdon Towers Sample HVAC.rvt' in Revit 2026 with the 'Snowdon Towers Sample Architectural' link loaded, and open the Model Context panel (RevitDevTool tab > Model Context).
Choose Scope 'Whole model' in the panel.
In the document list check only 'Current model'.
Open the Filter tab and click + (New custom filter).
Open Categories and check Doors.
Read the number before 'matches' in the result row: it must be 0.

Check without the panel: open Snowdon Towers Sample HVAC.rvt (do not save), create a schedule (View > Schedules > Schedule/Quantities) of Doors with 'Itemize every instance' on, turn on Grand totals > Count and read the total. Close the file without saving.

cases.description: Whole model, link checked: Doors in both: Doors
manualSteps: Open 'Snowdon Towers Sample HVAC.rvt' in Revit 2026 with the 'Snowdon Towers Sample Architectural' link loaded, and open the Model Context panel (RevitDevTool tab > Model Context).
Choose Scope 'Whole model' in the panel.

Open the Filter tab and click + (New custom filter).
Open Categories and check Doors.
Read the number before 'matches' in the result row: it must be 142.

Check without the panel: open Snowdon Towers Sample HVAC.rvt with 'Include elements in links' checked on the schedule (do not save), create a schedule (View > Schedules > Schedule/Quantities) of Doors with 'Itemize every instance' on, turn on Grand totals > Count and read the total. cases.description: Active view, Current model, every listed category, annotation included
manualSteps: Open 'Snowdon Towers Sample HVAC.rvt' in Revit 2026 with the 'Snowdon Towers Sample Architectural' link loaded, and open the Model Context panel (RevitDevTool tab > Model Context).
Make floor plan 'L3' the active view, then choose Scope 'Active view' in the panel.
In the document list check only 'Current model'.
Open the Filter tab and click + (New custom filter).
Leave Categories empty (every listed category counts).
Read the number before 'matches' in the result row: it must be 1041.

Check without the panel: in view L3 drag a selection window over the whole plan and click Filter (Modify tab); the dialog counts the Current model elements per category (every listed category). Revit has no dialog that counts linked elements in a view, so the link part is checked by the oracle only.

cases.description: Active view, Swing Angle > 45 deg in both: Doors where Swing Angle is greater than "45°"
manualSteps: Open 'Snowdon Towers Sample HVAC.rvt' in Revit 2026 with the 'Snowdon Towers Sample Architectural' link loaded, and open the Model Context panel (RevitDevTool tab > Model Context).
Make floor plan 'L3' the active view, then choose Scope 'Active view' in the panel.
In the document list check 'Current model' and the 'Architectural' link.
Open the Filter tab and click + (New custom filter).
Open Categories and check Doors.
Click + Condition, pick parameter 'Swing Angle', operator 'is greater than', value '45°'.
Read the number before 'matches' in the result row: it must be 22.

Check without the panel: in view L3 drag a selection window over the whole plan and click Filter (Modify tab); the dialog counts the Current model elements per category (Doors). Revit has no dialog that counts linked elements in a view, so the link part is checked by the oracle only.
